cycle_position.summary: East Coast 2-4 unit values still rising into mid-2026: May 2026 Redfin medians up YoY in most candidate metros (Philadelphia +6.9%, Albany +6.2%, Hartford +12.8%, New Haven +17.9%, Bridgeport +8.1%; Scranton flat). Northern Virginia 2-4 unit supply is effectively zero on-market (Zillow category page for Prince William County read '0 Homes' for duplex/triplex, July 2026), pushing small-multifamily buyers to off-market channels. Rate environment per FY2026 debt sources still elevated vs 2021 lows.

National average ~5.04%, flat for several quarters (longest plateau in 25 years); stable assets 4.5-5.0%, value-add ~6.0%. Sector enters 2026 after absorbing the largest supply wave since the 1980s; vacancy 4.4% vs 5.2% 2010s average, expected to drift up near-term. CBRE's H1 2026 Cap Rate Survey (3,600 estimates, 50+ markets) adds the per-class detail: Class A 4.74% flat, Class B compressed to 4.92%, Class C 5.38%; gateway core (NY/Boston/LA) most compressed at 4-5%, secondary/value-add 5.5-6.5%; infill multifamily the most bearish subtype. As-of 2026-08-25 pass (prior 08-21).
~6.0% per 2026 outlook coverage; single point, not a band.

top_east_coast_metros.metro: DMV core (DC / PG County MD / NoVA)
top_east_coast_metros.why: Home market. DC: pre-1976 stock rent-stabilized UNLESS the verified natural-person <=4-unit exemption applies (LLC disqualifies) — post-1975 buildings exempt entirely; TOPA timeline on every purchase. PG County: PRSA cap (lesser of 6% or CPI-U+3%) with the natural-person <=5-unit exemption (no domicile condition per county FAQ). NoVA: no rent control anywhere, but near-zero on-market 2-4 inventory (Prince William read 0 listings in July 2026) — off-market sourcing (tax-delinquency pipeline verified in July 15 pass) is the entry.

top_east_coast_metros.why: No rent cap and cheap dated stock, but license-before-rent (no license = no right to collect) and the code-violation rent freeze invert the value-add sequence: license, cure, then reposition. Ranked below the four above for an out-of-area first buy.

small_investor_verdict.entry_vehicle: Direct purchase as natural person; 2-4 units on residential financing (conventional investor or FHA house-hack on 3-4 units); hold title personally where small-landlord exemptions require it (DC: personal title mandatory for the exemption; PG: natural person or living trust).
small_investor_verdict.reasoning: The 2-4 unit tier is the one asset class where a $1-2M cash position buys controlling positions in multiple buildings with residential debt, and where the DC/PG regulatory exemptions specifically reward natural-person ownership. Verified regulation mapping (DC § 42-3502.05 3-0, Philadelphia § 9-811 3-0) plus fetched market depth (Redfin May 2026) support Philadelphia, Albany, Scranton, Providence as expansion metros and the DMV as the exemption-aware home market.
